title: `ObjectChart` has no refusal path for an unresolvable legacy binding — the prerequisite for retiring the forced-path `'name'` / `'value'` floors at three faces (objectui#7547)
body:
Split out of objectui#7547 by its implementing seat, on a measurement that contradicted the card's assumed route. Filed as a sub-issue rather than decided inside #7547.

## What #7547 assumed, and what is actually there

#7547 routes the chart `'name'` / `'value'` floors down the objectui#7029 / #7070 / #7500 road: delete the literal, and the renderer's own refusal screen becomes reachable. objectui#7070 wrote the discipline that road depends on, verbatim in its seam note:

> #7029's mechanic is only correct where a refusal path exists

For calendar that path was `ObjectCalendar`'s "Calendar configuration required" screen; for gantt, `ObjectGantt`'s; objectui#7500 got `ObjectTimeline`'s from objectui#7459, which landed **as its own card first**.

**`ObjectChart` has no such screen.** Measured on `20316bac3`:

- `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx` — `runAggregate` passes `schema.aggregate` straight to `ds.aggregate(objectName, { field, function, groupBy, filter })` with no guard on `groupBy`, and the `ds.find` leg hands the same bag to `aggregateRecords`, which buckets on `record[groupBy] ?? 'Unknown'`.
- The only two loud states are `error` (set from a thrown fetch, `data-testid="chart-error"`, `role="alert"`) and the generic "No data yet" empty state. Neither is a statement about an absent binding, and which one appears for `groupBy: undefined` is decided by the data source, not by this component.

So deleting the floors today does not produce an honest refusal — it produces a backend-dependent outcome. That is why #7547 measured this, left the floors standing, and reported instead of deciding.

## The three faces still carrying the floors

Line numbers on `20316bac3`:

- `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:2727-2728` — `chartBinding.valueField || 'value'` and `chartBinding.categoryField || 'name'`. The branch already names this card's parent in a comment ("The floors themselves are objectui#7547 ... deliberately untouched here").
- `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx:1518-1519` — the same pair.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:2157-2159` — `chartConfig.xAxisField || 'name'` and `yAxisFields[0] || 'value'`. The site triage found that the original card did not account for.

## Corroborating evidence that `'value'` in particular is harmful

`ObjectChart.tsx` already carries a note about the same literal arriving from the dashboard wiring, which is independent of this route:

> The upstream dashboard wiring defaults `field: 'value'` for charts without an explicit valueField, which crashes on SQL drivers ("no such column: value") since dashboards typically count rows, not a measure column.

The structured-aggregate leg works around it by omitting `field` for `count`. The legacy leg does not.

## What this card is

Give `ObjectChart` the refusal `ObjectTimeline` got in objectui#7459: when the legacy shape is routed with no declared category and no declared measure, say so instead of aggregating on a name nobody wrote. `resolveListChartBinding` in `ListView.tsx` already computes exactly that predicate (`resolves`, with the floors deliberately not applied), so the question is answered upstream and only needs a screen.

Once it exists, retiring the six literals at the three faces above is mechanical and is the remainder of objectui#7547.

## Not a decision this card should make alone

Whether the refusal belongs in `ObjectChart` (reached by every producer, including the dashboard widgets that still supply `'name'` / `'value'` themselves) or at the three relays is the design question. Stating it here rather than assuming it.

## Dedup

`search_issues` on this repo for a chart refusal path / unresolved legacy aggregate binding: one unrelated hit (objectui#6864, `aggregate()`'s spec-shape branch dropping filter and measure). Positive control in the same session returned objectui#7544 as its first result, so the near-zero is a reading.

Refs: objectui#7547 · objectui#7029 · objectui#7070 · objectui#7459 · objectui#7500 · objectui#7544 · objectstack#13748.

Recorded by the seat implementing objectui#7547 (`session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`). Unassigned, for triage.
